S. 49</ls>; in the <ab>ex.</ab> गौरश्वः पुरुषो हस्ती there is आकाङ्क्षा. .²3 Looking at or towards. .²4 Purpose, intention. .²5 Inquiry. .²6 The significance of a word. .²7 Expectancy. असत्यामाकाङ्क्षायां संनिधानमकारणम्, <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 4. 23</ls>.
